blockingFindings.finding: The head, beret, ears, lower legs, shoes and large portions of both wings are cropped from the five-view sheet; several pose frames also omit required body regions.
The bodice is a rigid rectangular tube positioned below the chest, exposing the bust and failing to form the reference sailor crop-top silhouette.
The puff sleeves and detached arm warmers are oversized cylinders with visible planar end caps rather than finished open fabric shells.
The sailor collar is represented by detached sharp triangular plates that visibly float beside the bodice.
The skirt reads as a simple rigid cone and the cream hem trim as a thick capped ring instead of a layered mini-skirt with lace or frill.
The wings are stacks of overlapping oval solids, and the shoes, leg warmers and charms remain coarse proxy forms.
Crouch, sit and prone show severe inversions, interpenetration and detached-looking layered components; all six poses contain evaluated body-garment intersections.

nextAction: Replace capped primitives with open multi-ring garment shells, use rigid bone attachment for accessories, correct the sailor bodice and collar silhouette, and reframe every view before the next direct review.
